title: Role of uterine stromal-epithelial crosstalk in embryo implantation
finding_used_by_endotwin: Review of the PGR-IHH-NR2F2-BMP2-HAND2 cross-compartment backbone. Topic-level support only; not primary evidence for any single edge.

title: Ablation of Indian hedgehog in the murine uterus results in aberrant estrogen signaling and infertility
finding_used_by_endotwin: Uterine Ihh is required for normal stromal response and restraint of epithelial estrogenic signalling (mouse).

title: COUP-TFII mediates progesterone regulation of uterine implantation by controlling ER activity
finding_used_by_endotwin: Epithelial Ihh -> stromal COUP-TFII (NR2F2) -> BMP2, with BMP2 add-back rescue (mouse). Never mentions HAND2 (citation to S_BMP2->S_HAND2 retracted in the prototype, CIT-025).

title: Bmp2 is critical for the murine uterine decidual response
finding_used_by_endotwin: Uterine Bmp2 is required for the decidual response (mouse conditional knockout).

title: The antiproliferative action of progesterone in uterine epithelium is mediated by Hand2
finding_used_by_endotwin: Progesterone induces stromal Hand2; Hand2 deletion derepresses stromal Fgf1/2/9/18 and sustains epithelial Ki-67 proliferation (mouse). FGF-to-epithelium step inferred, not demonstrated (no FGF add-back or FGFR blockade).

title: Evidence for a conserved function of heart and neural crest derivatives expressed transcript 2 in mouse and human decidualization
finding_used_by_endotwin: HAND2 is induced in and required for decidualization in mouse and human stromal cells.

title: Progestin-induced heart and neural crest derivatives-expressed transcript 2 inhibits angiopoietin 2 via fibroblast growth factor 9 in human endometrial stromal cells
finding_used_by_endotwin: HAND2 siRNA raises FGF9 under E2+MPA in human ESC. Of six FGF genes measured only FGF9 is progestin-regulated: evidence AGAINST an aggregate FGF mitogen node. No epithelium studied.

title: Bone morphogenetic protein 2 functions via a conserved signaling pathway involving Wnt4 to regulate uterine decidualization in the mouse and the human
finding_used_by_endotwin: Recombinant BMP2 on top of E2+P+cAMP further stimulates human stromal differentiation and WNT4: BMP2 has determinants beyond PGR.

title: Indian hedgehog and its targets in human endometrium: menstrual cycle expression and response to CDB-2914
journal: Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism
finding_used_by_endotwin: IHH, PTCH1, SMO, GLI1/2 present in human endometrium, compartment-resolved; IHH and GLI1 rise in the secretory phase.

title: SOX4 facilitates PGR protein stability and FOXO1 expression conducive for human endometrial decidualization
finding_used_by_endotwin: Candidate PGR-SOX4-FOXO1 arm for progesterone-responsive decidualization (alternative Q1 hypothesis). Shows a requirement for the increment above a P4+cAMP protocol; does not establish FOXO1 sufficiency. Not encoded as a node.

title: Importance of CEBPbeta binding and histone acetylation status in the promoter regions for induction of IGFBP-1, PRL and Mn-SOD by cAMP in human endometrial stromal cells
finding_used_by_endotwin: cAMP-dependent CEBPB binding and H3K27ac gate IGFBP1 and PRL induction (cAMP arm of decidualization).

title: Organoid co-culture model of the human endometrium in a fully synthetic extracellular matrix enables the study of epithelial-stromal crosstalk
finding_used_by_endotwin: IL1B 1 ng/mL suppresses stromal EdU and PRL secretion and dysregulates epithelial proliferation via the stroma (n=3).

title: Impaired bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) signaling pathways disrupt decidualization in endometriosis
system: human primary stromal cells and assembloids; control and endometriosis donors
evidence_depth: full_text_read_in_prototype_U4b (docs/v05_u4b_candidate_node_closure.md section 3.1); staged as DRREF-009, not in context/literature/references.tsv
finding_used_by_endotwin: pSMAD1/5 measured across a decidualization time course; SMAD1/5 siRNA impairs decidualization (IGFBP1, WNT4 down); BMP2 add-back rescues in 2D and assembloids; BMP2 induction and pSMAD1/5 both blunted in endometriosis.

title: Interleukin-1 beta and the endometrium: an inhibitor of stromal cell differentiation and possible autoregulator of decidualization in humans
finding_used_by_endotwin: IL-1beta gives incomplete decidualization: about 40% less PRL and 85% less IGFBP-1 released.

title: Interleukin-1beta inhibits estrogen receptor-alpha, progesterone receptors A and B and biomarkers of human endometrial stromal cell differentiation: implications for endometriosis
system: human primary stromal cells, control and endometriosis donors
finding_used_by_endotwin: IL-1beta causes rapid phosphorylation and depletion of ER-alpha, PR and Cx43 and lowers PRL and IGFBP-1; ERK1/2 blockade restores them.

title: Interleukin-1beta induces and accelerates human endometrial stromal cell senescence and impairs decidualization via the c-Jun N-terminal kinase pathway
finding_used_by_endotwin: IL-1beta impairs decidualization and induces senescence via JNK. Cited by the ENDO-TWIN proposal for the IL-1beta perturbation.

title: Negative interaction between the RelA(p65) subunit of NF-kappaB and the progesterone receptor
finding_used_by_endotwin: Mutual repression of RelA and PR. Mechanistic plausibility only for an inflammation-to-PGR route; not endometrial evidence.

title: Tankyrase inhibition stabilizes axin and antagonizes Wnt signalling
finding_used_by_endotwin: XAV939 mechanism (TNKS1/2 inhibition). No endometrial tissue; does not establish which ADOC compartment XAV939 acts on.

title: Mapping the temporal and spatial dynamics of the human endometrium in vivo and in vitro
finding_used_by_endotwin: WNT downregulation increases secretory/ciliated differentiation efficiency in endometrial organoids (context for XAV939; not encoded).

title: Modeling human embryo adhesion using a microfluidic platform
system: ADOC (human organoid epithelium + primary stroma on chip)
evidence_depth: in_house_full_text (data/sciadv.adz2249.pdf; evidence rows SOFIA-* in context/evidence-register.tsv)
finding_used_by_endotwin: Published ADOC regimen, PRL/IGFBP-1/PAEP outlet ELISAs, scRNA-seq (E-MTAB-15842) with BMP2 in hormone-treated stroma.

title: Progestins regulate the expression and activity of the forkhead transcription factor FOXO1 in differentiating human endometrium
finding_used_by_endotwin: cAMP confines FOXO1 to the nucleus; MPA co-treatment attenuates without abolishing nuclear FOXO1.

title: Forkhead transcription factor FOXO1A is critical for induction of human decidualization
finding_used_by_endotwin: FOXO1A knockdown lowers PRL and IGFBP-1 together. Placental decidual tissue, not non-pregnant endometrium.

title: FOXO1A differentially regulates genes of decidualization
finding_used_by_endotwin: FOXO1A silencing lowers IGFBP1 but raises PRL; the siRNA also hits FOXO3A.

title: Dysregulation of in vitro decidualization of human endometrial stromal cells by insulin via transcriptional inhibition of forkhead box protein O1
finding_used_by_endotwin: FOXO1 activity inhibitor AS1842856 collapses IGFBP1 while PRL is unchanged (n=6; a null, not an equivalence).

title: Role of FOXO1A in the regulation of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein-1 in human endometrial cells: interaction with progesterone receptor
finding_used_by_endotwin: FOXO1A and PGR interact at the IGFBP1 promoter; FOXO1A silencing lowers IGFBP1. Interaction sign is cell-type dependent.

title: HoxA-11 and FOXO1A cooperate to regulate decidual prolactin expression: towards inferring the core transcriptional regulators of decidual genes
finding_used_by_endotwin: FOXO1A alone is inert on the decidual PRL enhancer; only HOXA11 plus FOXO1A activate it.

title: FOXO1 is required for binding of PR on IRF4, novel transcriptional regulator of endometrial stromal decidualization
finding_used_by_endotwin: FOXO1 is required for PR binding at IRF4; IRF4 knockdown attenuates IGFBP1, PRL and WNT4.

title: Reduced signaling through the hedgehog pathway in the uterine stroma causes deferred implantation and embryonic loss
finding_used_by_endotwin: Partial stromal Smo loss defers implantation; does not show that reception is needed for NR2F2 (GAP-014 open).

title: Stromal estrogen receptors mediate mitogenic effects of estradiol on uterine epithelium
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
finding_used_by_endotwin: Epithelial proliferation in response to E2 requires stromal, not epithelial, ERalpha (tissue recombination).
